title: "[Subtask] <Description of Work>"

---

## 🔹 Related Feature

_Link the main feature issue this belongs to (e.g., #7)_

---

## 📋 Task Description

_Describe what needs to be done in this subtask clearly and specifically._

Example:
> Create a `User` model with fields for `email`, `password_digest`, `role`, and `status`.

---

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

_How do we know this subtask is complete?_

- [ ] Code is written
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Meets functional expectations
- [ ] Reviewed or approved if needed

---

## 🔒 Notes & Tips

- Use this template for backend logic, UI forms, validations, etc.
- If it can be **worked on or tested independently**, it’s a good subtask.
- Keep subtasks small: aim for < 1 day of work.

---

## 🧠 Pro Tip

If you're unsure whether to make something a subtask, ask:
> “Can this be done, tested, or assigned on its own?”

If yes — it’s a subtask!
